about: Paraphrase set for bench/eval/run.ts paraphrase. Each group: one target note that answers its questions, one distractor note that shares words with it but does not answer them (it says something different or the opposite), and questions of four kinds: lexical (the note's own words, the control), synonym (key words replaced by synonyms), low-overlap (no content word in common with the target note), and negation or date (a negated question, or a date written another way). Groups stay whole in one split. Written by the project's AI coding agent (Claude Code), checked against the criteria in bench/paraphrase/check.ts; not reviewed by an independent person.

target.text:
# Kitchen

The dishwasher is run every evening at 6 pm by whoever leaves the office last. It is never run during working hours. Detergent tablets are in the cupboard under the sink.

distractor.text:
# Home kitchen

At home the dishwasher runs on the eco cycle overnight. Detergent tablets are bought in bulk once a month.

queries.text: When is the office dishwasher run?
At what hour does the workplace dish machine get started?
What time do cups and plates get washed at our workplace?
When is the office dishwasher not run?

target.text:
# Parking

The staff car park is not open on Sundays. On every other day it opens at 7 am.

distractor.text:
# Summer fair

During the summer fair the car park is open all weekend, including Sunday, for visitors.

queries.text: Is the staff car park open on Sundays?
Which day is the employee parking lot shut?
When can't we leave vehicles near work?
On which day is staff parking not available?

target.text:
# Lease

distractor.text:
# Insurance

queries.text: By when must the office lease be renewed?
What is the deadline to extend the rental agreement for our premises?
How long do we have to keep renting this building?
What has to be done before 2027-03-14?
